can_in1_reference_zone_declared.note: Declaration presence only; continuity, clearance, and impedance remain manual/supplier checks.

can_reference_zone_coverage_bounds.scope: F.Cu CANH/CANL endpoint bounds against declared In1.Cu GND_CAN_ISO polygons
can_reference_zone_coverage_bounds.note: Polygon-bound coverage does not prove the filled copper shape, clearance voids, or return-current continuity.

can_differential_impedance.note: Layer choice and aggregate length do not prove 120-ohm differential impedance.

can_pair_coupling_and_stub_geometry.note: Branched CAN totals are not differential length; review coupled runs and connector, TVS, testpoint, and termination stubs manually.

can_branched_path_correspondence.note: Branch presence and layer parity do not prove matching endpoint paths; compare each CANH/CANL connector, protection, testpoint, and termination branch manually.

can_testpoint_stub_geometry.note: TP6/TP7 are constrained to short, same-layer, paired probe branches; differential coupling and probe loading still require oscilloscope review.

machine_evidence.scope: F.Cu CANH/CANL endpoint bounds against declared In1.Cu GND_CAN_ISO polygons
machine_evidence.note: Polygon-bound coverage does not prove the filled copper shape, clearance voids, or return-current continuity.

can_reference_plane_continuity.note: Candidate signal layers do not prove a continuous adjacent GND_CAN_ISO reference plane; review plane coverage and return-path discontinuities manually.

oscillator_return_path_and_load.note: Top-layer routing and zero vias do not prove crystal load, return-path, or EMI margin.

VBAT_FUSED.allowed_use: LTC4368 VIN monitor branch and package escapes

INPUT_SENSE.allowed_use: Kelvin sense branch from RS1 to LTC4368 SENSE

VBAT_PROTECTED.allowed_use: LTC4368 VOUT monitor branch and package escapes

12V_ISO.allowed_use: parallel eFuse pins, decoupling, feedback, and control branches

JETSON_12V.allowed_use: parallel eFuse output pins and PGOOD divider branch

high_current_path_semantics_and_thermal.note: Geometric neckdown limits do not prove that only monitor, feedback, and package-escape current uses the narrow segments; review extracted current paths, IR drop, SOA, and copper temperature.

reference_layer_signal_occupancy.note: Low-speed routing on a reference layer can fragment return-current copper even when net categories pass.

u3_microvia_fabrication.note: U3 uses 0.45/0.15 mm F.Cu-to-In1.Cu laser microvias in its exposed pad. The supplier must approve copper filling, capping, planarization, registration, and assembly voiding controls.

raw_can_blind_via_fabrication.note: CANH_RAW and CANL_RAW use matched 0.60/0.30 mm F.Cu-to-In3.Cu blind vias. The supplier must approve controlled-depth drilling, aspect ratio, registration, plating reliability, lamination sequence, and the resulting impedance discontinuity.

u7_isolated_power_safety_suitability.note: The full-layer board keepout preserves the available U7 pad-row gap, but the MEJ1S0305SC candidate specifies only 2 mm creepage/clearance and 200 Vrms working voltage. It cannot close the 8 mm reinforced system-isolation target without a replacement or documented safety decision.
